body:
For a secondary-minimal plateau response optimum, a Hall-tight set of generic interior rows can neighbor only strict source isolates. The proof replaces all neighbors simultaneously and slightly expands the inserted packet inside the hull, preserving every label and making every new contact/diameter pair strict. This identifies all interior-matroid coloops as strict isolates, permits individual contacted reaction vertices to become Schur terminals under the deep-first basis rule, and removes the mandatory isolate matching block without changing the Schur response.

An exact unbounded regression shows the limit of this reduction: saturated triangular chambers have full positive contact/facet stress, a zero fixed-hull cone, an interior three-channel fan, zero fan lens basis penalty, and zero coarse Hall deficiency and Schur nullity. An explicit staggered rectangle strictly beats the complete source at the same cardinality for every M >= 33. A global three-point plateau fixture also rules out unrestricted simultaneous selection of all three reaction terminals.

Classification: proved candidates awaiting independent review, plus exact regressions; artifact lifecycle remains unreviewed. Independent mathematical scrutiny is requested before any promotion. Level I and the canonical frontier remain open. The missing theorem is still the global source-response sector surplus (or a strict full-source competitor), with the zero-slack branch separate. No canonical state or prompt is promoted or changed.

Dependencies are canonical Target A Sections 99/102/113 (matching and Schur response), 165 (uniform response choice), 169/172 (locked response and reaction fan), 175/177 (closure and lens terminology), and shared Lemma 21.1 (finite Oler, only for the chamber's fixed-container capacity). The report distinguishes its coembedded locked regression from Sections 149 and 152, retains all physical source isolates, keeps independent source matchings separate, and uses neither full-source ZR/ZF nor an infinitesimal motion as a finite competitor.

Validation:

- Exact certificate under normal Python and `python3 -O`: 187,200 source pairs; 1,140,415 packet pairs; 42 exchange pairs; all 1,023 nonempty right subsets for M=4; complete basis/fan/equilibrium checks; global three-point fixture and two hypothesis controls.
- `python3 tools/check_theorem_state.py`: passed.
- Repository theorem-state, PR-state, and active-route unit tests: 22 passed.
- Artifact index/header generation, new relative-link check, and staged whitespace check: passed.
- Arbitrary-size and all-translation conclusions are proved analytically in the report; finite computation is not an infinite proof or a large-source global-optimality certificate.
- Remote CI is not verified: the preceding Actions attempt did not start any steps because GitHub reported failed account payments or a spending-limit block. The current head's `state-consistency` job is queued. All validation listed above ran locally.

Seed: 63. Category: Target A Schur deficiency and response capacity. Base: ab6dd3336f9f8d440f2bada76edb32153391cddc, state 2026-10-10.audit.234.
